title: Classic Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with chicken, zero-calorie sauce, and Algerian spices. This dish is a staple of Algerian cuisine, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: zero-calorie sauce
ingredients.notes: use a sugar-free and calorie-free sauce

ingredients.name: algerian tagine
ingredients.notes: a traditional clay pot or substitute with a slow cooker

instructions: Season the chicken with Algerian spice blend.
Heat the olive oil in the Algerian tagine or slow cooker over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and zero-calorie sauce to the tagine.
Add the seasoned chicken to the tagine.
Cook the chicken in the tagine or slow cooker on low for 30 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
